summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon, a Sri Lankan politician born September 6, 1971. It states he belongs to the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna and was elected to the Parliament of Sri Lanka for Kandy District in the 2004 election as a United People's Freedom Alliance candidate. It also notes he resides in Kandy.
one_line: Sri Lankan politician of the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna, elected to Parliament for Kandy District in 2004.
key_facts: Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon was born on September 6, 1971.
Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon is a Sri Lankan politician.
Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon belongs to the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna.
Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon was elected as a representative of Kandy District in the Parliament of Sri Lanka in the 2004 election.
Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon stood as a United People's Freedom Alliance candidate in the 2004 election.
Dimuthu Bandara Abayakoon resides in Kandy.
